name: Plex
summary: Plays episodes from your own Plex server, with its audio and subtitle tracks.
description: Connects Yume to a Plex Media Server you have access to and streams the episodes in your own library. Matches shows by the external id Plex stores on them — the HAMA agent records AniDB ids, and newer agents record TVDB and TMDB — falling back to a title search when the library carries none. Returns the original file rather than a transcode, plus the audio and subtitle tracks it contains.

server_url.description: Your Plex Media Server. Must match the host allowed in this extension's permissions.

token.description: An X-Plex-Token for your account. Grants access to your library, so treat it like a password.

section.description: Optional library section key to search. Leave empty to search every show library.

max_height.description: Reported resolution ceiling. Direct play ignores it; it only labels the source.
